verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Postmark ships an official MCP server (postmarkapp.com/lp/mcp, ActiveCampaign/postmark-mcp repo), which fits the AI-agent connectivity axis for an email SaaS product. However, evidence shows this landed amid confusion with a malicious unofficial 'postmark-mcp' npm package impersonating it, and the official repo has minimal adoption (1 watch, 0 forks, 2 stars), with no first-party documentation of it in the main docs/llms.txt pack. Missing for 10: official first-party MCP documentation/setup guide, independent hands-on verification of the official server's tool coverage, and evidence of broader adoption/trust.
